relations.text: アルツハイマー病薬LEQEMBIを共同で販売している
relations.text_en: Biogen and Eisai co-commercialize LEQEMBI, an anti-amyloid antibody for Alzheimer's disease

source.label: Biogen 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: We and our collaboration partner Eisai co-commercialize LEQEMBI, an anti-amyloid antibody for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease.

relations.text: RITUXANやOCREVUSなどに関する事業上・財務上の権利を得る契約がある
relations.text_en: Biogen has agreements with Genentech giving certain business and financial rights for RITUXAN, OCREVUS and other products

source.label: Biogen 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: We have agreements with Genentech that entitle us to certain business and financial rights with respect to RITUXAN, RITUXAN HYCELA, GAZYVA, OCREVUS, LUNSUMIO and COLUMVI, as well as the option to add other potential anti-CD20 therapies.

companies.name: サムスン・バイオエピス

relations.text: BENEPALI、IMRALDI、FLIXABIを同社との契約に基づき一部の海外市場で販売している
relations.text_en: Biogen commercializes BENEPALI, IMRALDI and FLIXABI in certain international markets under its agreement with Samsung Bioepis

source.label: Biogen 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: We commercialize BENEPALI, IMRALDI and FLIXABI pursuant to our agreement with Samsung Bioepis in certain international markets.

companies.name: スーパーナス・ファーマシューティカルズ

relations.text: ZURZUVAEの商業化で協業している
relations.text_en: Biogen collaborates with Supernus on the commercialization of ZURZUVAE for PPD

source.label: Biogen 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: We also have collaborations with Eisai on the commercialization of LEQEMBI for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease and Supernus on the commercialization of ZURZUVAE for the treatment of PPD.

companies.name: アイオニス・ファーマシューティカルズ

relations.text: SPINRAZAの世界純売上高に応じてロイヤルティを支払っている
relations.text_en: Biogen pays Ionis royalties on annual worldwide net sales of SPINRAZA

source.label: Biogen 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: We make royalty payments to Ionis on annual worldwide net sales of SPINRAZA

relations.text: VUMERITYの世界純売上高に応じてロイヤルティを支払っている
relations.text_en: Biogen pays Alkermes royalties on worldwide net sales of VUMERITY

source.label: Biogen 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: We make royalty payments to Alkermes on worldwide net sales of VUMERITY

companies.name: デナリ・セラピューティクス

relations.text: 共同開発者の立場にあるデナリの普通株を保有している
relations.text_en: Biogen holds Denali common stock and is a collaborator of Denali

source.label: Biogen 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Our ability to liquidate our investments in Denali may be limited by the size of our interest, the volume of market-related activity, our concentrated level of ownership and potential restrictions resulting from our status as a collaborator.

relations.text: 競合するアルツハイマー病薬KISUNLAを開発している
relations.text_en: Eli Lilly developed KISUNLA, a competing treatment for early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease

source.label: Biogen 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: A competing product, KISUNLA, a treatment for early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease that was developed by Eli Lilly and Company
